scope: Correct AC1018–AC1032 2D/3D POLYLINE VERTEX and SEQEND ownership roles. Preserve AC1015 and mesh/polyface encoding; this does not qualify ODA child geometry or whole-file interoperability.
authority: ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.16–17 specifies hard-owner VERTEX handles for R2004+ and hard-owner SEQEND. Independently authored ODA producer samples in all five revisions contain role 3 for all three child references and SEQEND, with child owner role 4.
witness: ezdxf 1.4.5 scratch source, ODA File Converter 27.1.0 with audit=1 DXF→requested DWG, LibreDWG 0.14 peer decoding; source role counts and XYZ are checked by tools/audit_polyline_owner_census.py with SHA-bound DWG and version argument. Output DXF target in the AC1021 conversion matrix is AC1027.
changes: For AC1018+ fixed POLYLINE_2D/3D only, emit each child and SEQEND as role-3 hard owner. Legacy AC1015, mesh and polyface paths remain unchanged. The source caller handle values and ordering are unchanged.

controlled_oda_results.baseline: Native reader and LibreDWG find all three children and geometry in generated role-5 DWG. ODA AC1027 DXF contains only two (0,0,0) VERTEX records for 2D and mixed; 3D has Out of range .err and no DXF.
controlled_oda_results.role_factorial: Both roles independently set to 3 or 5 (four parent-role combinations), for 2D and 3D: 2D still outputs two zero vertices, 3D still produces .err/no DXF. This role fix is justified by spec/source and does not resolve the ODA geometry defect.
controlled_oda_results.diagnostic_only: A scratch explicit absent-string bit on the 3D parent removes its fatal and yields a DXF, but still two zero vertices. Scratch exact parent/child/SEQEND boundaries, with role 3 or 5 and with independently changed xdictionary/BYLAYER defaults, also retain the two-zero-vertex loss. Those changes are not included in this patch.
controlled_oda_results.production: ODA final role-3 production output: 2D and mixed still lose a vertex and coordinates; 3D still fails. Preserve these results as unresolved, despite successfully parsed source and native peer readback.

procedure: c++ -std=c++17 -I. -Isrc -Isrc/intern -Itests tools/probe_ac1021_curve_geometry.cpp build-gcc/libdxfrw.a -o PRODUCER; run PRODUCER MODE NEW_OUTPUT.dwg with MODE line, spline, hatch, polyline2d, polyline3d or mixed

Convert source DXFs with ODA ACAD2004/2007/2010/2013/2018 DWG audit=1; for each producer DWG run python3 -B tools/audit_polyline_owner_census.py --dwgread /opt/homebrew/bin/dwgread --dwg DWG --sha256 RECORDED_SHA --version AC1018|AC1021|AC1024|AC1027|AC1032 --mode 2d|3d

Use ODA ACAD2013 DXF on AC1021 DWGs for the recorded output matrix, and inspect expected geometry with tools/audit_ac1021_curve_geometry_peer.py; pairing reflects the recorded local converter run, not proof of lineage from hashes alone.

validation.facade: tests/dwg_polyline_owner_facade_tests.cpp: 10 cases across five versions and two subtypes verify a duplicate-child collision is refused with caller state restored, corrected same-facade retry, compound receipt, following LINE and native readback.
validation.independent: ODA-produced source census 10/10 and peer geometry source/generated role controls. Fixture-free AC1021 direct parser test checks reconstructed historical role-5 and role-3 child/SEQEND tokens; full pre-fix generated files also parsed three exact vertices natively.
validation.literal: tests/dwg_polyline_owned_handle_roles_tests.cpp: six revisions, two subtypes, direct role and following-handle assertions; mesh/polyface and AC1015 unchanged, plus AC1021 role-5 historical and role-3 native parser controls. Red control against a pre-fix scratch archive fails on AC1018 as expected.
validation.addressSanitizer: ctest --test-dir build-asan-custom -R '^libdxfrw_dwg_polyline_(owned_handle_roles|owner_facade)$' --output-on-failure: 2/2 passed after rebuilding the role-fix targets with AddressSanitizer.

limits: No whole-file ODA success claim or claim that role correction fixes observed child loss.
Only source-witnessed 2D and 3D POLYLINE types are changed, excluding mesh/polyface.
No new binary fixtures; local path artifacts are reproducible scratch and hashes are run-specific.
